digest.component_or_area: import parser and CLI help generation
propositions: Current import documentation does not describe 256-event batching chunks for independent create, parent, file-impact, verify-command, and comment passes.
Canonical import help must be updated to document deferred push behavior and per-event link and status pass behavior.
Generated CLI help and CLI reference artifacts must be regenerated from canonical parser help to reflect current batching and deferred-push behavior.
User guidance must explicitly document that whole-file atomicity is not provided and partial tickets will not be automatically completed after import failure.
Serial source_id-based resumption is supported but concurrent imports risk duplicate creation and incomplete tickets between passes.
